notes: Minimal IPyth interface — getPriceUnsafe (read-only, no fee) + getPriceNoOlderThan (built-in staleness gate). Pyth on MegaETH is a single contract; per-asset feeds are addressed by bytes32 priceId, NOT by separate contract addresses. Address verified live on MegaETH mainnet AND testnet (same contract address by design — Pyth uses CREATE2). Reference: https://docs.pyth.network/price-feeds/contract-addresses/evm and https://github.com/pyth-network/pyth-sdk-solidity/blob/main/IPyth.sol
